rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Duende kecil kehijauan berbulu berjanggut, mata bulat hitam, topi merah dan pedang kecil; naik ke dada penidur.

visual_requirements.description: Kecil berbulu dengan kulit kehijauan, banyak gigi, mata bulat hitam, janggut, baju tua buram, topi merah dan pedang kecil tajam.
Masuk rumah malam hari dan naik ke dada penidur; tanpa sihir visual.
Ranjang dalam rumah pada malam hari.

aura: Keganjilan mata bulat hitam dan banyak gigi plus pedang c02 di dekat dada penidur c03, tanpa pembesaran ukuran.
artistic_choices: Sudut pandang penidur dengan dada tertutup selimut; tidak ada wajah atau tubuh korban tampak dan tidak ada penggunaan pedang untuk melukai.
Ukuran kecil ditegaskan lipatan selimut/pillow lebih besar; framing makro memberi dominasi tanpa raksasa.
Warna busana cokelat, arah cahaya bulan dan postur mencondong ke penonton editorial. Tidak menggambar varian hewan, urin atau aura mimpi buruk.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Tardo, the small malevolent Galician duende that enters houses at night and sits on sleepers' chests.
ANATOMY: exactly one tiny hairy greenish humanoid with one head, two ROUND BLACK eyes, a thick ragged beard, a mouth crowded with MANY small sharp teeth; two normal arms and two legs. Old fully opaque brown clothes, a conspicuous worn RED CAP, and one SMALL SHARP iron SWORD held in one hand [tardo-c02]. No pointed ears, horns or wings.
MOMENT: SCRAMBLING up the chest-shaped mound beneath a thick quilt directly toward the viewer's pillow, shoulders hunched and mouth opened in a predatory many-toothed snarl, one hand presses into quilt to brace, the other grips the small sword away to the side. Not attacking flesh [tardo-c03].
POWER: physical oppressive nightmare presence on a sleeper's covered chest; no visible spell, aura or smoke creature.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme macro low viewpoint from the pillow; tiny duende fills most of square through proximity, giant-looking normal quilt stitches and a full-size pillow behind demonstrate its smallness, never a giant goblin.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one narrow moonbeam from the bedroom window, antique-gold rim on sword and red cap, deep walnut shadows under the beard.
SURFACE: coarse matted hair, greenish wrinkled skin, old opaque cloth, pitted iron, heavy quilt weave.
SETTING: dark human bedroom at night, the sleeper entirely hidden beneath the quilt and out of frame; no face or exposed person visible [tardo-c03].
MOOD: menacing and unnerving at tiny scale, dangerous and confronting, never cute, cartoonish or calmly posed.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: exactly one tiny sword and one red cap; no extra heads, limbs, fingers, horns or wings; no victim visible, nudity, injury or gore; no text, logo, frame, border or watermark; no borrowed entertainment design; no glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
